<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Fallen Sword. Thank you for responding to our request, but it’s all over.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|— ''The Captain'', chapter 10}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Sola Kalter Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Sola [[Kalter]], also known as Sola or the [[Fallen Sword]], is a highly skilled mercenary and gun for hire. Known to some as a myth, she possesses an extensive knowledge of the [[Iron Legion]], an organization that serves as her primary target for a personal crusade. Sola is characterized by her immense combat prowess, an extensive collection of weaponry, and a unique ability to utilize [[Aethertech]] weapons with exceptional efficiency. Her specialized gray [[combat armor]] is masterwork in quality, featuring temperature regulation and advanced [[Aethertech]] components that allow her to keep pace with certain temporal fields. In her role as [[The Sword|the Sword]] of [[The Last Horizon]], she serves to protect the ship's captain and ensure the safety of its bridges. Her arsenal includes a weapon known as [[Worldslayer]], which she has used in battle against enemies such as [[Sel’miroth]]. Sola's background includes a period spent at an orphanage on [[Dornoth IV|Dornoth Four]], and she has distant relatives in the [[Dornoth system]] who face social persecution for being associated with the [[Karoshan|Karoshans]]. Despite her solitary nature and professional focus on destroying the [[Iron Legion]], she has demonstrated a capacity for protection and loyalty to her allies.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Sola is a gray titan with pale gray skin and bright green eyes, one of which shines with a deathly green light. She wears bulky, temperature-regulated gray power armor equipped with a silver helmet, an emerald visor, and suit speakers. Her armor can be dispersed into floating blue cubes or summoned mid-stride.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A reliable gun for hire and a Knight of the [[Titan Force]], Sola is a warrior on a crusade dedicated to dismantling the [[Iron Legion]]. She is a stoic and prepared crew member of [[The Last Horizon]] who follows plans, though she can experience frustration and fear during battle. She is a cautious individual who believes there is always a trap.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Sola is a companion to [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]], who operates the cruiser. She is a crewmate of [[Omega]] and has fought [[Aila Escalon]]. Sola also questioned if [[Queen Shyrax]] was a master, though she later nodded to the queen's command. Additionally, Sola told [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] to stay alive and once won an exchange against [[Aila Escalon|Aila]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Sola possesses extraordinary compatibility with [[Aethertech]] weapons and can summon the [[Worldslayer]] or a [[Suncaster L-14]] from her inventory. Her combat skills include using a two-handed lightning gun that fires magic-keyed lances of light, utilizing [[pulse boosters]] or Temporal Fields to dash, and wielding a flame of resurrection. Additionally, she can split her flame into several pieces and use a unique spell that exceeds [[Archmage]]-level power.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Fallen Sword}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Known by the codename [[Fallen Sword]], Sola [[Kalter]] is a combatant who wears power armor that provides visual alerts and warnings.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c10">''The Captain'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c17">''The Captain'', chapter 17</ref> The narrator expects to meet this individual, who possesses pale gray skin, an eye shining with deathly green light, and the marks of the [[Lichborn]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c16">''The Captain'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18">''The Captain'', chapter 18</ref> Bound to both her armor and her greatest gun, Sola can split her Flame into several pieces and possesses a unique spell that exceeds [[Archmage]]-level.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18" /> She utilizes a lightning-powered, two-handed gun that requires charging to fire magic-keyed lances of light, and her weapons can dissolve into particles to enter her inventory.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18" /> This gun is capable of annihilating an entire hall, and Sola demonstrates extraordinary compatibility with [[Aethertech]] weapons.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c19">''The Captain'', chapter 19</ref> A gun for hire and a Knight of the [[Titan Force]], Sola possesses a flame of resurrection and lives by the motto, 'If it’s not [[Iron Legion]], call someone else.'<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c19" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c21">''The Captain'', chapter 21</ref> While she spends her time dismantling the [[Iron Legion]] as a warrior on a crusade, she is also recognized as [[The Sword|the Sword]] of [[The Last Horizon]] and the possessor of a [[Worldslayer]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c26">''The Captain'', chapter 26</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c28">''The Captain'', chapter 28</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c29">''The Captain'', chapter 29</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Companion of Varic}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Sola [[Kalter]], also referred to as Miss [[Kalter]], wears [[Aethertech armor]] featuring a green visor.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c4">''The Knight'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c21">''The Knight'', chapter 21</ref> A reliable worker for hire who prefers sticking to the [[Iron Legion]], she is currently fulfilling another contract.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c15">''The Knight'', chapter 15</ref> As a companion of [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] and a crew member of [[The Last Horizon]], she operates the cruiser and uses the [[Worldslayer]] to shoot [[Sel’miroth]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c16">''The Knight'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c17">''The Knight'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c37">''The Knight'', chapter 37</ref> Communicating via a processor, she reports problems and summarizes situational reports while following established plans.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c14">''The Knight'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c16" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c18">''The Knight'', chapter 18</ref> During her duties on the ship, she has been seen guarding the bridge, inspecting the [[Zenith Cannon]] before handing it over to [[Omega]], and operating a console to unload missiles and [[Subspace torpedoes]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c22">''The Knight'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c38">''The Knight'', chapter 38</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c40">''The Knight'', chapter 40</ref> While her ability to use weapons was once limited by shield maintenance, she has also been tasked with targeting the [[Visiri]] and warned that traveling to the [[The Heart of Visiria|Heart of Visiria]] was a foolish risk.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c35">''The Knight'', chapter 35</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c36">''The Knight'', chapter 36</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c37" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Vice Chief of Horizon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a pilot for one of [[Horizon]]'s shuttles, Sola [[Kalter]] serves as the [[Vice Chief of Planetary Security|Vice Chief]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c3">''The Pilot'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c4">''The Pilot'', chapter 4</ref> She wears temperature-regulated [[combat armor]] held in a frame and utilizes a green visor.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c4" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8">''The Pilot'', chapter 8</ref> Equipped with a gun that uses impact rounds, Sola manages sensor displays by tapping images and tossing them onto holo-projectors.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c4" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c10">''The Pilot'', chapter 10</ref> Sola observes that the [[Hive]] contains everything required to make a King.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c10" /> Capable of firing weapons from her ship, she requested permission to unleash green fury upon [[Omega’s daughter|Omega's daughter]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c12">''The Pilot'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14">''The Pilot'', chapter 14</ref> During combat, she utilizes clones that engage Temporal Fields and successfully won an exchange against [[Aila Escalon|Aila]] by splattering her across [[Dornoth]]'s orbit.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c15">''The Pilot'', chapter 15</ref> Sola, who manufactures her own ammunition and possesses a green [[Lichborn]] eye, can project station maps from a wrist console on her armor.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c19">''The Pilot'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c20">''The Pilot'', chapter 20</ref> Communicating through an [[audio implant]], she experiences both fear and frustration during the battle.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c25">''The Pilot'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c28">''The Pilot'', chapter 28</ref> As a crewmate of [[Omega]], she uses a gun to target and control weaponry while fighting a clone of [[Aila Escalon|Aila]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29">''The Pilot'', chapter 29</ref> If killed, Sola would return to the ship, though she currently lacks armor and must use a [[matter reduction grenade|matter-reduction grenade]] from her [[Subspace inventory]] while her gun dissolves into cubes of light.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30">''The Pilot'', chapter 30</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Titan Force headquarters}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|While walking through the [[Titan Force headquarters]], Sola [[Kalter]] is clad in full armor.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32">''The Pilot'', chapter 32</ref> Sola maintains a cautious mindset, believing that a trap is always present.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c35">''The Pilot'', chapter 35</ref> A gray titan with family residing on Fathom, Sola possesses the ability to conjure a handgun and activate a [[Temporal Field]] to dash.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c37">''The Pilot'', chapter 37</ref> Sola's helmet is equipped with speakers and the character is mourning a friend who died.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c37" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c40">''The Pilot'', chapter 40</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Shuttle passenger}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Sola [[Kalter]] travels as a passenger aboard the shuttle.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c42">''The Pilot'', chapter 42</ref> She is known to [[Aila Escalon]] as a former combatant.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c44">''The Pilot'', chapter 44</ref> During movement, Sola possesses the ability to summon her armor mid-stride and can emerge safely from her [[Pyre]] while on a ship.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47">''The Pilot'', chapter 47</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48">''The Pilot'', chapter 48</ref> While aboard [[The Last Horizon]], she redirected power through the vessel's weapons systems and advised the Captain to depart.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c49">''The Pilot'', chapter 49</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Fallen Sword. Thank you for responding to our request, but it’s all over.”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c10" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“I am Sola Kalter, Sword of The Last Horizon. I’m here to ensure that the bridge is safe for my captain.”<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“And is she a master?” Sola asked him, though Shyrax was more than close enough to hear.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“Is he going to come for us again?” Sola asked.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c39" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|“If we can lock down the Zenith Cannon, we should.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c8" />}}
